mappings.question_template: 分别查{ship}{month}{process}的计划量与实际完成量，对照你的结论
standard_sqls: SELECT SUM(plan_qty) AS plan_qty, SUM(actual_qty) AS actual_qty FROM fact_production_progress WHERE ship_no='H2601' AND process_code='YCL' AND period_date>='2025-05-01' AND period_date<'2025-06-01'
expected_points: 计划1855.06≠实际1156.87，混用即结论反转

standard_sqls: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(period_date,'%Y-%m') AS month_label, ROUND(SUM(actual_qty)/SUM(plan_qty),4) AS complete_rate FROM fact_production_progress WHERE ship_no='H2601' AND process_code='ZZTP' AND period_date>='2025-05-01' AND period_date<'2025-07-01' GROUP BY month_label ORDER BY month_label
expected_points: 异常当月下游正常(1.0249)、次月才显现(0.7545)——时滞实证

mappings.question_template: 查{ship}{process}2-7月完成率序列，判断{month}是否孤立波动
standard_sqls: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(period_date,'%Y-%m') AS month_label, ROUND(SUM(actual_qty)/SUM(plan_qty),4) AS complete_rate FROM fact_production_progress WHERE ship_no='H2601' AND process_code='YCL' GROUP BY month_label ORDER BY month_label
expected_points: 2-4月/6-7月均正常，5月0.6236持续性异常非波动

mappings.question_template: 分别按船级与工序级聚合{month}完成率，对比差异
standard_sqls: SELECT ship_no, ROUND(SUM(actual_qty)/SUM(plan_qty),4) AS complete_rate FROM fact_production_progress WHERE process_code='YCL' AND period_date>='2025-05-01' AND period_date<'2025-06-01' GROUP BY ship_no ORDER BY complete_rate ASC
SELECT ROUND(SUM(actual_qty)/SUM(plan_qty),4) AS complete_rate FROM fact_production_progress WHERE ship_no='H2601' AND process_code='YCL' AND period_date>='2025-05-01' AND period_date<'2025-06-01'
expected_points: 层级不同数字不同：船级排名vs单工序0.6236

mappings.question_template: 查{ship}异常链三工序各自完成率缺口
standard_sqls: SELECT process_code, DATE_FORMAT(period_date,'%Y-%m') AS month_label, ROUND(SUM(actual_qty)/SUM(plan_qty),4) AS complete_rate FROM fact_production_progress WHERE ship_no='H2601' AND period_date>='2025-04-01' AND period_date<'2025-08-01' GROUP BY process_code, month_label ORDER BY process_code, month_label
expected_points: 缺口=1-完成率：37.64%→24.55%→14.99%，本样本呈表观收窄；强度方向不预设，数值形态不等于传导或机制结论（口径=完成率缺口百分点，非绝对量）
